# CRAWLIX PRO
> Enterprise-grade search engine and generative AI optimization audit engine created by Ahmad Jalhoom (أحمد جلهوم).

## Project Overview
CRAWLIX PRO performs multi-dimensional real-time audits across 5 critical vectors:
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization & AI crawler readiness)
- Web Performance & Speed (Core Web Vitals & DOM efficiency)
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Modern Web Security & HTTP Headers

## Lead Architect & Founder
- Ahmad Jalhoom (أحمد جلهوم)
- Portfolio: https://ahmedsaleh.website
- Framework: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Node.js 24 + Tailwind CSS v4
